https://github.com/victronenergy/dbus-mqtt — vendor's own repository, records the deprecation at Venus OS v3.20.
https://www.victronenergy.com/media/pg/Cerbo_GX/en/ — Cerbo GX manual MQTT section: local broker on 8883 (SSL) and 1883 (plain), depending on the security profile.

transport: Ethernet or WiFi · MQTT against the GX's own broker (dbus-flashmq) · TCP 1883 plain, 8883 TLS, 9001 websockets · no authentication for local connections · OFF by default; which ports are offered depends on the configured network security profile — 1883 appears only on 'weak' or 'unsecured'
blocks: A topic tree, not registers; the topic path IS the D-Bus path. N/<VRM portal ID>/<service_type>/<device instance>/<D-Bus path> for notifications · W/… to write · R/… to force a re-read · R/<VRM portal ID>/keepalive or the broker goes quiet (60 s timeout) · N/<VRM portal ID>/full_publish_completed marks the end of a full dump.

sharedMapEvidence: Same Venus OS D-Bus tree, different encoding. The MQTT topic path is literally the D-Bus path that the Modbus workbook lists in its `dbus-obj-path` column, so the two dialects are two views of one map — and the model evidence therefore transfers wholesale from the Modbus dialect above (workbook has no model column, attributes.csv has no model dimension, Ekrano's own §17.2). `dbus-flashmq`'s README
gotchas: dbus-mqtt is deprecated. Victron: 'Since Venus OS v3.20, this project has been replaced with dbus-flashmq.' Anything written against the old dbus-mqtt README describes a service that is no longer running.

The broker goes quiet unless the client republishes R/<portal ID>/keepalive. The vendor states the 60 s timeout only. The 55 s republish interval is a community convention and a driver choice — do not cite 55 s as vendor-doc.

Topics are addressed by VRM portal ID, derived from the GX's MAC address. A driver must discover it (it is also register 800 over Modbus) rather than have it configured, or the config rots the day the hardware is replaced.
Port 1883 does not exist under the default security profile. A driver that hardcodes 1883 fails on a stock GX; 8883 with TLS is what a default install offers.
full-publish-completed-echo only exists from Venus OS 3.50. Version-gate anything that depends on it.
unmappedReports: Identical to victron-gx-modbus-tcp — both dialects expose the same D-Bus tree, so that entire list applies unchanged, Plus everything under per-device /Alarms/*, /History/* and /Settings/* that has no Modbus register at all — not enumerated in any vendor document and deliberately not guessed at here
